composing_text: one tank company and heavy artillery of the coast force (Miller, ch. VI)
source_locator: R2225: ch. VI (Sumiyoshi’s coast force attacked across the Matanikau sand bar, 23 October); R2228: C25080233000 p. 22 (stamp 0572), Sumiyoshi Force attacked the Inu position on the Matanikau right bank from 14:00 on 23 October, Oka Force from the flank and another force from the front, with artillery cooperating
current_activity: attacking across the Matanikau sand bar ahead of the inland assault
notes: Miller, chapter VI: on 23 October 1942 Sumiyoshi’s coast force (the 4th Infantry, a tank company, and heavy artillery) attacked across the Matanikau sand bar; the inland 2nd Division had not yet reached its line of departure. Confidence 0.5 (one US official family). Confidence is raised from 0.5 to 0.7. The 17th Army operations record (JACAR C25080233000, stamp 0572) independently confirms that Sumiyoshi Force attacked the Matanikau right-bank Inu position from 14:00 on 23 October, which agrees with Miller, chapter VI (the coast-force attack across the Matanikau sand bar that day).
